# PRFlow Review — PR #1952

**Verdict: APPROVE**

**Reviewed HEAD:** 50a02cfc04021f25c6faa35ae558e5250a4c6a25 (local, == PR head)
**Diff profile:** small_diff + config_only + engine_self_modifying (engine_self_modifying overrides checklist → full Phase 1+2 checklist run)

## Diff under review

Three Markdown files, 31 insertions / 14 deletions:
- `.changeset/issue-1833-vendored-upstream-pins.md` — new changeset (bump: patch, type: Changed), well-formed, uniquely named, cites #1952, does not touch plugin.json/CHANGELOG.
- `LICENSES/README.md` — adds a "Last reconciled against" provenance column to two vendored-file tables (7 Anthropic-plugin agent rows → claude-plugins-official commit b819188d2eea14e0400556ca29dbd1179a7c595b; 3 superpowers rows → `superpowers 6.3.0`) plus an explanatory paragraph disclosing that no automated drift check maintains the column.
- `skills/requesting-code-review/code-reviewer.md` — adds a "## Review In Multiple Passes Yourself" section to the vendored reviewer prompt (never dispatch a subagent for part of the diff or a second opinion; review in multiple passes yourself; names the cost consequence).

## Issue Compliance (issue #1833, 8 acceptance criteria — source: workpad)

All 8 satisfied:
1. LICENSES/README.md records last-reconciled upstream revision for every vendored row (10 rows) — SATISFIED.
2. Existing upstream/license/Apache §4(b) content preserved (diff only widens tables + inserts one paragraph) — SATISFIED.
3. code-reviewer.md directs no-sub-reviewer (part-of-diff and second-opinion), multi-pass self-review, and names the cost consequence — SATISFIED.
4. Added section is repo-agnostic (no PRFlow suite commands, step numbers, or CLAUDE.md citation) — verified by grep — SATISFIED.
5. No upstream `## Common Rationalizations` table content introduced — verified absent — SATISFIED.
6. Existing local adaptations of code-reviewer.md (read-only rewording, removed praise sections) preserved — SATISFIED.
7. No drift-check workflow/script/job and no new agent file under agents/ — verified via --name-only — SATISFIED.
8. No lib/test pin exists over the edited prose; the two existing run.sh pins on code-reviewer.md target the untouched mutation-guard sentences — nothing to reconcile — SATISFIED.

## Phase 3 review agents

Four reviewers dispatched (fanned-out), all returned clean:
- code-reviewer: clean — repo-agnostic vendored body confirmed, changeset conforms, existing content pins untouched.
- silent-failure-hunter: clean — no executable code; added prose introduces no silent-failure hazard; manual-pin absence honestly disclosed.
- comment-analyzer: clean — explanatory paragraph consistent with actual table populations/kinds; manual-pin rot risk explicitly disclosed.
- requesting-code-review (final-pass): APPROVE — all 8 ACs verified against tree, changeset well-formed.

Gated out of the Phase 3 roster: type-design-analyzer (has_new_types=false), pr-test-analyzer (config_only test-relevance predicate skips).

## Verdict

APPROVE. A clean, well-scoped documentation/provenance change with an honest disclosure of the manual (undriven) nature of the new pin column. No findings at any severity.
